_about: The words said when code the page fetches later did not arrive (./load-code.ts CodeLoadReason). Each reason has `why` (what happened) and `then` (what the person does). A part drawn later (./later.ts) shows `why` as its title and `then` beside it, inline in its place; a whole screen (src/workspace/lazy-screen.ts) shows both under its own title. `retry` asks again in place, offered only when the connection was the reason; `reload` fetches the page anew, offered when only that can help, and every `then` that offers it says to save work first.

unreached.then: Check your connection, then try again.

replaced.then: Save your work, then reload the page to open this.

stuck.why: Some of this page's code did not arrive
stuck.then: Save your work, then reload the page to fetch it.

broken.then: Save your work, then reload the page to fetch it anew.
